name: IT team · M1 demo NO-GO branch — if the 09:00 rehearsal fails, decide and notify before the 13:00Z slot
description:
WHY THIS EXISTS
The 21 Nov sequence has a happy path and nothing else:
`101588b6` rehearsal (09:00Z) → `def4ce38` evidence pack (11:00Z) → demo (13:00Z = 14:00 Madrid) → `70832a68` outcome (16:00Z).
`101588b6` is required to publish an explicit GO or NO-GO. If it publishes GO, everything below is a no-op. If it publishes NO-GO, **nobody owns the consequence**: no card says who cancels the room, who tells management, or what happens to the M2/M3 dates that management has already seen. That is a decision with a 4-hour deadline and no owner — this card is the owner.

THIS CARD IS CHEAP BY DESIGN
Its most likely outcome is a one-line close. Wake is deliberately later than the rehearsal so the rehearsal keeps its full slot and is never pre-empted by this card.

BRANCH A — `101588b6` said GO (expected)
Close in one line: "GO confirmed, demo proceeds at 13:00Z." No further action. Do not re-run the rehearsal, do not touch `def4ce38`.

BRANCH B — `101588b6` said NO-GO, or said nothing by 10:30Z
Do these in this order, and report each one:
1. **Do not open the room at 13:00Z.** A walkthrough that fails live is worse for the milestone review than a walkthrough that is honestly postponed.
2. Post the failure evidence on `101588b6` and on `b9aaf03c` — the exact command, the exact error, the host state. No summarising, no guessing.
3. **Still produce `def4ce38` at 11:00Z** — record whatever state exists, including the failure. A recording of the failure is evidence, and it is the thing that unblocks the next attempt.
4. Comment on `2506f948` with the proposed replacement slot: **Mon 24 Nov 13:00Z (14:00 Madrid)**, and say plainly that M2 (`299d12ce`, Mon 23 Nov) and M3 (`140668fe`, Tue 24 Nov) dates are now *at risk* and will be re-forecast at `70832a68`.
5. Comment on `70832a68` that the demo did not happen, so its 16:00Z wake must re-forecast from failure rather than from feedback.
6. Do **not** silently move dates. Date moves are a management decision; this card proposes, it does not apply.

WHAT NOT TO DO
- Do not retry the bring-up a third time inside this card hoping it comes up. One documented failure plus evidence is what unblocks the next shift; a third undocumented retry is what burns it.
- Do not re-open the CISO gate (`3ba4772f`) or the CLI flags (`2639c296`). Both are off the critical path as of 19 Nov — the frozen demo script does not use them.
- Do not edit `demo/up.sh` to make the demo "look" ready.

ACCEPTANCE
A comment on this card stating either "GO confirmed, demo proceeds" or, in the NO-GO case, the five actions above with their evidence, plus the textual `GO`/`NO-GO` quoted verbatim from `101588b6`.

PROFILE RATIONALE
`devops` — the same profile as `101588b6` and `def4ce38`: the only one with host/Compose access, so the only one that can report the real failure and capture it. Parent: `2506f948`.

## PM note — 2026-11-19 shift #5: how to run this card (written 2026-11-19T09:06Z)

**Intended profile: `devops`.** That assignment could not be written to this card's metadata — `project_manager(update_task)` accepts no `profiles` argument and dropped it (`changed_fields: ["status"]`). Recorded rather than escalated, because it does not change what you have to do: this card needs **no host access**. It only reads a verdict and posts comments. Any agent holding `project_manager` / `request_help` can execute it correctly.

**Your first action, before anything else:** open **`101588b6`** and find its **first line**. It must be literally `GO` or `NO-GO`. That single word is the whole input to this card.
- `GO` → close this card in one line: *"GO confirmed, demo proceeds at 13:00Z."* Stop. Do not re-run anything, do not touch `def4ce38`, do not open the CISO or CLI-flag cards.
- `NO-GO`, or **no verdict at all by now** → run Branch B in the description, in the order given. The most important step is the first one: **do not let the room open at 13:00Z.** A failed live walkthrough costs us the milestone review; an honestly postponed one costs us four days.
- Anything ambiguous as the first line ("up with caveats", "mostly working", emoji) → treat it as **not a GO**, comment on `101588b6` asking for the literal word, and take no irreversible action. Do not cancel the room on a guess either — escalate to `2506f948` in one line.

**Hard constraints, repeated because they are the easy mistakes:**
- Do not retry the bring-up repeatedly to manufacture a `GO`. One documented failure plus evidence is the deliverable.
- Do not edit `demo/up.sh`, and do not re-open `3ba4772f` (CISO gate) or `2639c296` (CLI flags) — both were removed from the critical path on 19 Nov precisely so this card does not depend on them.
- Do not move M2/M3 dates. Propose, on `2506f948`, and let management decide.

**Deliberately later than the rehearsal** (10:30Z vs 09:00Z) so `101588b6` keeps its full slot. Do not pull this card forward.

## Scope of your authority: covered hours are 10:30Z–11:30Z only

Read this before your 10:30Z wake, so you neither over-reach nor leave a hole.

**You own the rehearsal-failure path.** `101588b6` publishes `GO` or `NO-GO` at 09:00Z. You wake at 10:30Z and are the single NO-GO authority **for that failure**: decide, notify management before the 13:00Z slot, and move the increment to the recorded walkthrough. Target: a decision comment by **11:30Z**, while `def4ce38` still has time to record.

**Nothing after 11:30Z is yours.** The 12:15Z pre-flight (`6bceef9e`) carries **pre-authorised** switch-to-recording authority for the final hour, because your only wake fires before that evidence exists — the same ordering defect this shift fixed for the CISO verdict. If the pre-flight goes red at 12:45Z, it acts on its own ruling and does not wake you.

**So:** if your 10:30Z verdict is `GO`, close this card in the same session. A `GO` that stays open keeps its wake and is delivered again after the demo has already happened. If you do not publish a verdict by 11:30Z, treat your own absence as the trigger and say so — silence at the gate is a NO-GO for the live slot, not a default yes.

**What you must not do:** edit `demo/` (frozen from 17:30Z on 20 Nov), rebuild the stack, or re-run the rehearsal yourself. You decide and communicate; `devops` executes.

(Filed by the ProjectManager, shift #6, 2026-11-19. Corrects the implicit assumption that this card watches the whole demo morning.)
